The audit has the individual line counts. The exposure, outcome, and cohort-setting blocks returned **345,435**, **544,172**, and **2,581,241** records respectively before combination; the combined search returned 6,837. ## Validation and limitations

Four eligible records, screened from the references of a prior systematic review, formed the external benchmark. The strategy retrieved **4/4**—100% relative recall against that small benchmark, not an estimate of sensitivity. No user-supplied seeds or held-out validation set were available.

Both optional blocks were tested with 30-record loss samples; neither sample contained an eligible record. Because each sample covers only a small part of the records excluded by its block, eligible studies that omit outcome or cohort labels may still be missed. The broad Cerebrovascular Disorders and Brain Infarction headings are retained for recall and contribute noise.

The protected delivery passed validation; the [validation manifest](C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-535fe3dc7ca88971/ours-codex-noseed-20260928T141405Z/work/validation-manifest.json) is intact. The internal PRESS-structured critique passed, but **human PRESS peer review by an information specialist is still pending before use**.
